cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(athera_local_chat LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(LLAMA_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LLAMA_BUILD_SERVER OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LLAMA_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(llama.cpp)

add_library(athera_local_chat SHARED athera_local_chat.cpp)
target_compile_definitions(athera_local_chat PRIVATE ATHERA_BUILD_SHARED)
target_compile_features(athera_local_chat PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(athera_local_chat PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_link_libraries(athera_local_chat PRIVATE llama)
set_target_properties(athera_local_chat PROPERTIES CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
if(NOT ANDROID)
    add_executable(athera-chat worker.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(athera-chat PRIVATE athera_local_chat)
    target_compile_features(athera-chat PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
endif()
